steps.what: Direct environmental programs such as water compliance
Direct aboveground or underground storage tanks and spill prevention
Direct control of hazardous waste or materials management
Direct solid waste recycling and medical waste handling
Direct indoor quality, integrated pest management, and employee training
Direct disaster preparedness and stop if the site is unsafe

tasks.design: The manager directs environmental programs, such as water compliance, aboveground or underground storage tanks, spill prevention or control, hazardous waste or materials management, solid waste recycling, medical waste, indoor quality, integrated pest management, employee training, or disaster preparedness. Direction stays at full effort. Nothing in {OPS_SYSTEM} moves waste, runs a spill response, or files a disposal. The manager directs the people who do that work.
tasks.previous_blocker: The manager directed the programs on site and in the meeting.
tasks.enabler_now: No schedule directs the waste work.
tasks.still_hard: What is done on the site stays with the manager.
tasks.human_edge: The manager stops the work when the site is unsafe.
tasks.altitude: Direction of these programs stays at full effort, including waste handling.

reach.task: Carry out only what the manager directs

evidence.claim: Directing environmental programs, including waste handling, stays with the manager.

assumptions: The work starts with the site and ends when the manager has directed the program, or stops.
No disposal record is created by a rule. Upkeep is zero.
An audit of the same site is a different task.
unknowns: Which programs this site actually runs.
research_questions: Which programs did the manager stop?

already_counted.description: Directing the programs is already in the manager's step.

incremental.description: No new upkeep: the direction adds no record.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: every program is still directed by the manager. High: the same direction remains, with no waste step removed. No upkeep is added, so the low does not go below zero. The range stays under the net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The compliance manager still judges a breach, a sanction, and a policy change. A policy or a report is sent or filed only after the manager accepts that version.
reach: An employee reaches the manager directly with a confidential report.
A colleague receives only a policy the manager has accepted.
skills_to_grow: Stop when a required flag, interval, or figure is blank.
Accept or refuse the exact version before a write or a send.
Keep investigations, sanctions, and policy changes in their own hands.
role.ambitious_version: Every management report traces to a stored figure, and the manager still writes what it means.
